ns2:section.sectionText: BA Doctoral students in Year 1-3 of the program are required to register. Students in Year 4-6 are encouraged to attend. This course will meet in 2041 BIF. Sessions will be held as follows: February 7: Kick-off session with Tiffany White and Norma Scagnoli; February 21: Teaching and the Case Method by Joseph Mahoney; February 28: Student-led activities; March 7: How to Survive your PhD with Some Publications by Ruth Aguilera; March 14: Team Formation and Peer Assessments by Vishal Sachdev; April 4: Achieving a Successful and Satisfying Faculty Career by Joseph White; April 11: Integrating Teaching with Research and Outreach by Madhu Viswanathan: April 18: Mini Presentations by BA Dissertators.
